items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: The food from Ruth Sears, who still lives, although like she doesn’t cook up a feast anymore

ctx.x: Big Al Sears, who we haven’t mentioned since I gave short shrift to the Ellingtons, let’s not forget Big Al Sears. He was great. And to spend another second in his basement if it rains or in his backyard if it’s not, would be heaven. I would even trade you one of my rarer records for just one second of that in real time again. The food from Ruth Sears, who still lives, although like she doesn’t cook up a feast anymore, I think she’s like ninety something. But she still lives in the house. And Big Al Sears had…
Well it’s great because a lot of those fellas would get work in the studios even, playing.
